note: Hyper-K and IWCD geometry as WCSim e2dc7a48 builds it, exported to GDML by WCSim itself (WCSim publishes no GDML file: url and commit are of the WCSim source, export says how the file was written; the patches add the GDML writer and the three export-time changes of lumen_wc.wcsim, none of which changes the geometry). WCSim is MIT-licensed (its LICENSE at that commit). The export has export_sha256, the sha256 of the GDML each WCSim charge reference holds (references.json: products wcsim-hk-, wcsim-hk-id-, wcsim-hk-od- and wcsim-iwcd-e2dc7a48). Like SK's and WCTE's exports it writes inf in one GROUPVEL table (3 values, on a surface, which no Geant4 process reads), which Geant4 and lumen refuse; what ships is the copy python -m lumen.gdml.repair writes (repair), stored xz-compressed (<name>.gdml.xz); sha256 and bytes are of the decompressed file, checked when it is converted (lumen_wc.inputs).

hk.gdml.export: refs/wcsim/run.sh hk gdml (refs/wcsim/macros/hk.mac, macros/tuning_parameters_iwcd.mac; WCSim built with refs/wcsim/patches/wcsim_main_gdml.patch and wcsim_hk_export.patch against Geant4 10.7.4)
hk.gdml.repair: python -m lumen.gdml.repair EXPORT DST: matrix 'GROUPVEL0x558fd1e04150': 3 non-finite value(s) written +-1e30 (nothing else changed)
